channel.title: Gotta Pee! - Toilet-finding guides
channel.description: Practical guides to public toilets, travel, accessibility and everyday outings.

item.title: How to use Gotta Pee! to find, add and review a toilet
item.description: Learn how to use Gotta Pee! to find nearby toilets, choose facilities, navigate to a place, add a missing toilet and leave a review.

item.title: How to find toilets with baby changing facilities
item.description: Find a toilet with a baby changing table, check access with a pushchair and plan a family stop in an unfamiliar place using Gotta Pee!.

item.title: IBS and finding a toilet when you are away from home
item.description: Practical toilet planning for people with IBS: check nearby bathrooms, opening hours and access before going out, and know when to seek medical advice.

item.title: How to find a public toilet while travelling
item.description: Find a nearby restroom in an unfamiliar city: check opening hours, fees, facilities and the entrance, then plan your way there with Gotta Pee!.

item.title: Anxiety about finding a toilet in an unfamiliar place
item.description: Worried you will not find a toilet when you go out? A practical plan for unfamiliar places, the limits of toilet maps and when to seek professional help.

item.title: Finding suitable toilets for older adults when going out
item.description: Plan walks and journeys with suitable toilets for older adults: check step-free access, opening hours, comfortable routes and individual needs.

item.title: How to find an accessible toilet that meets your needs
item.description: An accessible toilet is more than a wheelchair symbol. Check the route, entrance, transfer space, equipment and access rules before setting off.

item.title: A worldwide toilet map with nearly half a million locations
item.description: Gotta Pee! helps you find toilets in Poland and abroad. Learn what nearly half a million map records mean and how to check a place before visiting.

item.title: Public toilets in Poland: a practical guide for visitors
item.description: Find public toilets in Poland with Gotta Pee! Understand local WC signs, check fees and find baby changing or accessible facilities using the English app.
